label: idScheme
comment: The identifier scheme of the party.  Typically a national business register or a global schem such as GLEIF.
The identifier scheme for this product.  Eg a GS1 GTIn or an AU Livestock NLIS, or similar. If self issued then use the party ID of the issuer.
The ID scheme of the facility. eg a GS1 GLN or a National land registry scheme. If self issued then use the prty ID of the facility owner.

domainIncludes.comment: An organisation.  May be a supply chain actor, a certifier, a government agency.
The product which is the subject of this conformity assessment
The facility which is the subject of this conformity assessment
